title: The scaler
logline: A man on the log deck with a scaling stick, 1994, measuring the last logs, chalking numbers on their ends. The numbers the page doesn't letter. The stack behind him. The last count.

panels.composition: A man in a hard hat on a log deck with a long scaling stick across a log's end, chalk marks on the cut ends of the logs around him, the stack behind, black spotting in the bark.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a man in a hard hat on a stack of logs holding a long scaling stick across a log's cut end, chalk marks on the ends of the logs around him, a brick stack behind, no words legible
